'''Darkmeld''' was a covert [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] organization created and led by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]]. The creation of Darkmeld was informally sanctioned by acting [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Kenth Hamner]] in [[43 ABY]] amidst tensions between the [[New Jedi Order]] and the [[Anti-Jedi sentiment/Legends|anti-Jedi]] policies of [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]].

==History==
[[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] created Darkmeld as a means of actively-but-secretly undermining [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]]'s [[Anti-Jedi sentiment/Legends|efforts]] to take control of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]]. The group originally included [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tekli]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Tahiri Veila]], [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]], former [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] agent [[Winter Celchu]], and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Jedi healer/Legends|healer]] [[Cilghal]]. Fel and Solo were initially unsure about adding [[Mirax Terrik Horn]] to the group as the organization would have to be kept secret from the Jedi Masters, including Terrik Horn's husband, [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], but they decided to include her anyway. Darkmeld soon [[Raid on the Armand Isard Correctional Facility|captured]] the [[Force psychosis|psychotic]] Jedi Knight [[Seff Hellin]] during his attempt to free [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]-[[Carbon-freezing/Legends|encased]] Jedi Knight [[Valin Horn]]&mdash;who suffered from the same psychosis&mdash;from the [[Armand Isard Correctional Facility]]. This allowed the Jedi Order to study the mysterious psychosis in hopes of finding a cure; and prevented the Galactic Alliance from encasing him in carbonite as they had done Horn.<ref name="Outcast" />

[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Cilghal]], a member of the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Council]], who was the only known Master in regular contact with Grand Master [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], found out about Hellin, and joined Darkmeld shortly thereafter.<ref name="Outcast" />

[[Lina Zev]] and [[Karn Valanti]] later served as doubles for Solo and Fel, respectively, when they wanted to go on a date free from the press. Zev and Valanti held the attention of [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Javis Tyrr]] long enough for Solo and Fel to find their way to an inn halfway around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="Omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref>
